# CANDIDATE: TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO

**Filed:** 2026-08-20
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** quality_gate
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Blocking call entries when bearish market structure is confirmed (via 5m-close-through-respected-ascending-support) will avoid losses on call trades during bearish structure without affecting PUT winners on J's anchor days, as the structure-based signal is orthogonal to the PUT-side ribbon-rejection trades.

## Mechanism

- Entry trigger: same as base strategy (e.g., vwap_continuation, ribbon_ride, etc.)
- Additional veto: if `market_structure.classify_trend` returns 'downtrend' on the 5m timeframe (same-day), then block CALL entries.
- PUT entries are unaffected by this veto.
- Exit logic remains unchanged (chart-stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, etc.).
- The veto is evaluated at the time of entry signal.
